code: Quantum ESPRESSO pw.x 7.5 (conda-forge qe-7.5-hc91ee90_1) through ASE
labelling: computed with DFT-PBE in this project: a model value (PBE), never a measurement

literature.source: T. Thomas, D. Pandey, U. V. Waghmare, Phys. Rev. B 77, 121203(R) (2008), Table I (glide set)
F. Shimojo, private communication, in P. Vashishta et al., J. Appl. Phys. 101, 103515 (2007), Sec. V.C (169 meV/A^2; glide or shuffle not stated)
Shimojo in Vashishta et al. 2007, Sec. V.C (1.5 meV/A^2)

records.name: unstable_stacking_fault_energy

orientation.description: glide set (narrowly spaced gap), (111)[11-2] twinning sense: maximum between 0 and b_p

conditions.stress_state: (111) fault displacement imposed by tilting the cell vector c; 0 K

method.name: DFT generalised stacking-fault energy (tilted cell, z-relaxed)
method.description: pw.x, PBE, SSSP_1.3.0_PBE_efficiency, ecutwfc 70 Ry / ecutrho 560 Ry, k-mesh (8, 8, 2) offset (0, 0, 0), gaussian smearing 0.01 Ry, conv_thr 1e-11 Ry/atom; 12-atom 1x1 (111) cell, 6 bilayers, k-mesh [8, 8, 2]; gamma = [E(s) - E(0)] / A
assumptions: 0 K static lattice (no zero-point or thermal effects)
tilted periodic cell, one fault per 6 (Si,C) bilayers (fault images 15.2 A apart), no free surfaces
relaxation along [111] only (in-plane coordinates and cell fixed)

checks.name: pw_runs_converged
checks.details: 24 pw.x runs: JOB DONE, SCF converged, BFGS converged for relaxations; max SCF iterations 17

checks.name: reference_cells_consistent
checks.details: glide- and shuffle-cut cells are the same crystal shifted along z: |dE|/A

provenance.device: cpu: 4 MPI rank(s) pinned to cores [10, 11, 12, 13]

runner.command: /home/lammspark01/miniconda3/envs/fmd-dft/bin/mpirun -np 4 --map-by pe-list=10,11,12,13:ordered --bind-to core --mca pml ob1 --mca btl self,sm -x OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 /home/lammspark01/miniconda3/envs/fmd-dft/bin/pw.x -nk 4
